name: S Craig Lindner
current_role: Co-Chief Executive Officer and Director, American Financial Group (NYSE: AFG), Cincinnati
profile: S. Craig Lindner (71), son of AFG founder Carl Lindner Jr., has been Co-CEO of insurance holding company American Financial Group since January 2005 alongside his brother Carl H. Lindner III, and was Co-President 1996-2023. He ran AFG's annuity arm (GAFRI) until its 2021 sale and remains primarily responsible for AFG's investment portfolio; he owns ~6.2% of AFG.
interesting_fact: He and his wife Frances led the effort to launch the Lindner Center of HOPE (2008), a $28M, 100,000 sq ft mental-health complex on 36 acres in Mason, Ohio, and he chairs its board; their families' $30M gift to UC established it.
deep_cut_fact: A 1977 UC business graduate (honorary doctorate 2016), he has chaired the annual Greater Cincinnati Classic Horse Show benefiting Shriners Hospitals for Children, and Project H.O.P.E. benefiting children in Langkloof, South Africa; he once sat on the board of Spelling Entertainment Group.
